items.title: Paul Barnes Interview, 1971-03-13
items.q: Yeah, I used to play on the Island Queen with Sidney Densene.

ctx.x: You didn't ever play on boats?

No, with none of them. Yeah, with him. Yeah, no, I never did play on boats. The only time I played on the boat was right here in New Orleans with Sidney Densene. Oh yeah. And we used to play on the Island Queen at the same boat that the government wanted to get rid of right now. Really? Yeah, I used to play on the Island Queen with Sidney Densene. Man, I played there a while. But it's a strange thing. I used to play plenty of schools. You called it the dance schools. You see, taxi dance, you used to call it. You…
